summary: Routing/navigation, Home page hero + “Join the Club” CTA, booking request backend methods, and several reusable UI components (bubble cards, decor stickers, nanny cam frame, auth gate) were added. However, the Parent Portal status/nanny-cam data is still stubbed on the frontend and there is no evidence of a backend API for those statuses/URL. The diff also introduces additional backend features (user profiles, booking admin/status updates, authorization initialization) that were not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend provides an API to read the current values/timestamps for Nap/Snack/Play statuses and the nanny cam media URL (or placeholder), and frontend fetches and displays them from the backend.
missing_requirements.reason: The frontend hook explicitly returns placeholder data and states it is waiting for backend implementation; the shown backend code implements bookings and user profiles but shows no status/nanny-cam read API in the provided (truncated) portion.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile management APIs (save/get user profiles) with authorization checks.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not ask for user profile CRUD; it only requests Parent Portal status/nanny-cam and booking request creation/listing.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin/authorization framework and secret-token based initialization for access control.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraints mention staying single-canister and using Internet Identity for access to Parent Portal, but do not request an admin-token initialization flow or custom access-control module integration.

hallucinated_features.description: Additional booking features beyond create/list (e.g., get booking by id, list all bookings with admin visibility, booking status updates).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-7 only requires create booking request and list booking requests for the signed-in user; extra admin/list-all/get-by-id/update-status functionality was not requested.
